author: Hate2Toss
body: Real Thai Food, Garden Grove. I’m not a local, was visiting and desired some Thai for dinner. Searched, found good reviews and loved it. Four of us, four different entrees and each was really good at a great price. The place is not much for looks but the waitress was attentive and pleasant and we really enjoyed the dinner. Will go again, if i get that way, to try more of the menu.
